emulator_note: All guest memory is host-backed via mem_map_ptr + ctypes buffers. The vendored and stock unicorn 2.1.x DLLs on this host intermittently return UC_ERR_*_UNMAPPED from the uc_mem_write/uc_mem_read API for mapped, executable pages (emulation itself is unaffected); fixture I/O therefore bypasses the API. Verified stable: 3 consecutive full-suite processes, identical results.
